summary_en: A detailed cooking show video demonstrates how to make strawberry milk tea smoothie in a modern kitchen. The hosts introduce fresh ingredients and guide viewers through dissolving milk tea powder, whipping cream, slicing strawberries to decorate glass jars, blending strawberries with milk, and topping the beverage with whipped cream and mint leaves. The video concludes with a summary and a detailed recipe screen for the audience.
